appName.description: Extension name. Product name — keep untranslated unless the locale has an established form.

appDescription.message: Automatically deletes visits to the websites you choose from your browser history.
appDescription.description: Web Store / extensions-page description. Max 132 characters.

optionsTitle.description: Browser tab title of the settings page.

tagline.message: Sites on this list never stay in your history.

siteInputLabel.description: Screen-reader label for the add-site text field.

siteInputPlaceholder.description: Keep the example domains as-is; they are not real sites.

addSwitchText.message: Keep the exact page above, only delete deeper ones
addSwitchText.description: Toggle next to the add field: keep the page that was typed, delete pages nested under it.

addSwitchHint.message: site.com/ stays, site.com/page goes — or scope it: site.com/forum/ stays, site.com/forum/post goes
addSwitchHint.description: Example line under the toggle. Shown in a monospace font; keep the URLs as-is.

cleanNowTitle.message: History is cleaned up automatically every 30 minutes and on Chrome startup. Click to clean up right now instead of waiting.
cleanNowTitle.description: Tooltip on the "Clean up now" button.

cleanNowBusy.description: "Clean up now" button label while a clean-up is running.

blockedSitesHeading.description: Heading above the rule list. Rendered uppercase.

filterLabel.description: Screen-reader label for the filter box.

emptyState.message: No sites yet. Add a domain (example.com) or a specific section (site.com/forum/) — matching pages, including subdomains, will be cleaned up automatically.

noMatches.description: Shown when the filter box hides every rule.

rowAllSubdomains.description: Note after a domain in the list: the rule also covers its subdomains.

rowAllSubdomainsScoped.description: Same note for a rule limited to one section of the site.

rowRemoveLabel.description: Screen-reader label for the ✕ button on a row.

rowKeepHomepage.description: Per-row toggle for a whole-domain rule.

rowKeepThisPage.description: Per-row toggle for a rule scoped to a section.

statusKeepOn.message: $SITE$ will stay — only deeper pages are removed.

statusKeepOff.message: Every page under $SITE$ will be removed.

hintNeedDomain.message: Type a domain first, e.g. example.com

hintInvalidDomain.message: "$INPUT$" doesn't look like a valid domain.

statusAddedKeep.message: Added $SITE$ — that page stays, deeper pages are removed.

saveErrorQuota.message: Couldn't save — sync storage is full (about 100 rules). Remove a rule and try again.

saveErrorTooManyWrites.message: Couldn't save — too many changes at once. Wait a moment and try again.

saveErrorUnknown.description: Substituted into saveErrorGeneric when the browser gives no reason.

statusNothingToClean.message: Add a site first — nothing to clean up yet.

statusNothingFound.message: Nothing matching found in your existing history.

statusCleanedUp_one.message: Cleaned up $COUNT$ matching entry from history.

statusCleanedUp_other.message: Cleaned up $COUNT$ matching entries from history.

exportEmpty.message: Add a site before exporting — the list is empty.

importNoSites.message: No valid sites found in that file.

autoSweepNever.message: Runs automatically every 30 minutes and on Chrome startup. No clean-up has run yet.

lastSweepLine.description: Footer line. $LABEL$ is one of the sweepLabel* messages, $TIME$ a relative time ("5 minutes ago"), $RESULT$ either sweepRemovedNothing or sweepRemoved_*.

justNow.description: Relative time for something that happened less than a minute ago.

sweepLabelInstall.description: The clean-up that runs once when the extension is installed or updated.

sweepLabelUnknown.description: Fallback label for a trigger this version doesn't know.
